messages.text: My order has not shipped after more than a month. What are my options?

Sorry about the wait — a month with no shipment isn't right. I can pull up the order and tell you exactly where it stands, plus your choices: an updated confirmed date, swapping to something in stock, or cancelling for a full refund to your original payment method.

What's the order number, and the email address on the order?
